title: Super 44
summary: A pixel-art racing world with an accessible HTML portfolio at its heart.
description: Super 44 combines a fictional circuit and pit garage with a developer portfolio. An original animated racer brings the scene to life while navigation and content remain HTML.

Projects, skills, about, and contact open in the same window. Shareable links preserve the selected section through refresh and browser history. Reduced motion and a visible motion control keep animation optional.
The portfolio is still in development. Verified personal information, more project stories, and real-device performance checks are still to come.
